posts.title: Winter Menu is Here!
posts.excerpt: Cranberry Walnut and Jalapeño Cheddar sourdough are back for the season. Plus, we're introducing Sourdough Discard Crackers.
content: We're kicking off 2026 with two of your favorite seasonal loaves returning to the lineup.
**Cranberry Walnut Sourdough** — Tart dried cranberries and toasted walnuts folded into our classic dough with a touch of honey. The perfect bread for your cheese board or morning toast.
**Jalapeño Cheddar Sourdough** — Sharp cheddar and fresh jalapeños from a local farm. This one sells out fast, so preorder to guarantee yours.
We're also excited to introduce **Sourdough Discard Crackers** as a permanent menu item! Thin, crispy, and ridiculously snackable. They pair perfectly with our loaves or on their own.
As always, you can preorder for Saturday pickup at the Castell Street Market. See you there!

posts.title: Free Sourdough Starter Kit — Now on Our Website
posts.excerpt: We built a free 4-day sourdough starter guide. No experience required. Start your own culture at home.
content: One of the most common questions we get at the market is: *"How do I start my own sourdough?"*
So we built a **free 4-day Starter Kit** right here on our website. It walks you through everything — from mixing your first flour and water on Day 1 to the float test on Day 4.
No experience required. No special equipment (besides a jar and a kitchen scale). Just flour, water, and patience.
The guide includes a downloadable cheat sheet and an FAQ section covering all the weird stuff that might happen (hooch, funky smells, slow starters).
Check it out at the Starter Kit page, and if you'd rather skip the wait, you can always pick up a jar of our live starter at the market!
Happy baking!

posts.title: Happy New Year from Knead & Bake TX!
posts.excerpt: A thank-you to everyone who supported us in 2025, and a preview of what's coming this year.
content: Happy New Year! 🎉
2025 was an incredible first year for Knead & Bake TX. What started as a hobby in our kitchen turned into something we never expected — a real community of bread lovers at the Castell Street Market.
**Some highlights from 2025:**
- Over 1,500 loaves baked and sold
- 12 seasonal flavors rotated through the menu
- Dozens of sourdough starters sent home with new bakers
- Zero loaves returned (we're proud of that one)
**What's coming in 2026:**
- Online preordering (you're looking at it!)
- New seasonal flavors every quarter
- A recipe section with our favorite sourdough recipes
- Possible pop-ups and collaborations with local businesses
Thank you for every loaf you've taken home, every kind word at the market, and every Instagram tag. We do this because of you.
See you Saturday! — Knead & Bake TX
